mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_tasks WHERE status IN (#{statuses}) AND created_at < #{cutoff}
SELECT * FROM agent_tasks WHERE status IN (#{statuses}) AND timeout_at < #{now}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_tasks WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = #{status} AND retry_count < max_retries
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_tasks WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND completed_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_tasks (task_id, session_id, task_type, task_params, status, retry_count, max_retries, result, error_message, created_at, started_at, completed_at, timeout_at, metadata) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskType}, #{taskParams}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetries}, #{result}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{timeoutAt}, #{metadata})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_tasks SET session_id = #{sessionId}, task_type = #{taskType}, task_params = #{taskParams}, status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, max_retries = #{maxRetries}, result = #{result}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, timeout_at = #{timeoutAt}, metadata = #{metadata} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
